en-US.desktop.agents.title: Agents
en-US.desktop.agents.noProject: Open a project to talk to an agent.
en-US.desktop.agents.unavailable: Agents are not available in this window.
en-US.desktop.agents.loading: Reading the agents of installed plugins…
en-US.desktop.agents.empty: No installed plugin provides an agent. Install an agent plugin, such as one for Claude Code or Codex, from the marketplace.
en-US.desktop.agents.noNativeMode: This agent cannot hold a conversation here: its plugin offers no native conversation, or it is not allowed to run programs.
en-US.desktop.agents.missed: Some updates of this conversation were lost; the transcript may be incomplete.
en-US.desktop.agents.grant.run: Run the command-line tool of each agent it declares, after you start a conversation or confirm an update
en-US.desktop.agents.grant.native: Relay the conversations of its own agents to Lithe
en-US.desktop.agents.grant.sessionsRead: Read the session files its agents' tools write, after you allow it in Settings
en-US.desktop.agents.grant.usageRead: Read token and cost totals of your agents, without conversation text, titles or directories
en-US.desktop.agents.turnEnded.maxTokens: The answer reached the agent's output limit.
en-US.desktop.agents.turnEnded.maxTurns: The agent reached its step limit.
en-US.desktop.agents.pluginRejected: The agents of {plugin} were not loaded: {reason}
en-US.desktop.agents.promptTooLong: The prompt is too long to send.
en-US.desktop.agents.cliMissing: Lithe can't find the command-line tool of {agent}. Plugins shows what is missing and installs it when the plugin offers an installer.
en-US.desktop.agents.updateDetail: The update runs the CLI's own update command in a terminal.
en-US.desktop.agents.reason.remoteWorkspace: agents run only in local workspaces
en-US.desktop.agents.reason.runNotGranted: the plugin is not allowed to run programs
en-US.desktop.agents.reason.tooManySessions: too many conversations are open; close one first
en-US.desktop.agents.reason.toolNotFound: its CLI was not found; install it or set its path in Settings
en-US.desktop.agents.reason.backendUnavailable: its plugin's backend did not start
en-US.desktop.agents.reason.backendStopped: its plugin's backend is not running
en-US.desktop.agents.history.noConsent: Lithe reads the session files of an agent's CLI only after you allow it in Settings.
en-US.desktop.agents.history.unsupported: No installed agent records its sessions.
en-US.desktop.agents.record.changed: The session file changed since Lithe read it. Read the sessions again to see it.
en-US.desktop.agents.record.limit: Only the first {count} of this session's messages are shown.
en-US.desktop.agents.record.tooLong: The rest of the session has a record line too long to show.
en-US.desktop.agents.record.empty: This part of the session holds no messages.
en-US.desktop.agents.settings.title: Agents
en-US.desktop.agents.settings.intro: Agent plugins can let Lithe read the session files their CLIs write, to list, search and resume past conversations. Lithe keeps what it reads in its cache and sends none of it anywhere.
en-US.desktop.agents.settings.readSessionsHelp: Turning a switch on lets Lithe read the files in the directories the plugin names. Turning it off stops reading them and drops what Lithe cached from them.
en-US.desktop.agents.settings.noPlugins: No installed plugin asks to read session files.
en-US.desktop.agents.settings.failed: The change could not be applied: {reason}
en-US.desktop.agents.settings.mcpSearchSwitch: Allow MCP clients to search local sessions
en-US.desktop.agents.settings.mcpSearchHelp: Lets the MCP clients of a project's IDE connection search and read the sessions of the agents allowed above, from every project. They get the agent, session ID, time and message text, never file paths. It takes effect while the IDE connection is on in Settings › Tools › IDE Connection; changing it reconnects the connection.

zh-CN.desktop.agents.title: Agent
zh-CN.desktop.agents.noProject: 打开项目后才能与 Agent 对话。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.loading: 正在读取已安装插件的 Agent…
zh-CN.desktop.agents.empty: 没有已安装的插件提供 Agent。请从插件市场安装 Agent 插件，例如 Claude Code 或 Codex 插件。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.noNativeMode: 此 Agent 无法在这里对话：插件没有提供原生对话，或者未获准运行程序。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.missed: 这段对话丢失了部分更新，内容可能不完整。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.grant.run: 在你开始对话或确认更新后，运行它声明的每个 Agent 的命令行工具
zh-CN.desktop.agents.grant.native: 把它自己的 Agent 对话转发给 Lithe
zh-CN.desktop.agents.grant.sessionsRead: 在你于设置中允许后，读取其 Agent 工具写下的会话文件
zh-CN.desktop.agents.grant.usageRead: 读取 Agent 的令牌和费用总数，不含对话内容、标题或目录
zh-CN.desktop.agents.turnEnded.maxTokens: 回答达到 Agent 的输出上限。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.cliMissing: 没有找到 {agent} 的命令行工具。可以在插件管理里查看缺少的命令；插件提供安装方式时可以直接安装。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.updateDetail: 更新会在终端中运行该 CLI 自己的更新命令。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.reason.remoteWorkspace: Agent 只能在本地工作区运行
zh-CN.desktop.agents.reason.tooManySessions: 打开的对话太多，请先关闭一个
zh-CN.desktop.agents.reason.toolNotFound: 找不到它的 CLI；请先安装，或在设置中指定路径
zh-CN.desktop.agents.history.noConsent: 只有在设置中允许后，Lithe 才会读取 Agent CLI 的会话文件。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.history.unsupported: 已安装的 Agent 都不记录会话。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.record.changed: 会话文件在 Lithe 读取后发生了变化。重新读取会话后再查看。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.record.tooLong: 会话后面有一行记录太长，无法显示。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.settings.title: Agent
zh-CN.desktop.agents.settings.intro: Agent 插件可以让 Lithe 读取其 CLI 写下的会话文件，用来列出、搜索和继续以前的对话。Lithe 只把读到的内容保存在本机缓存中，不会发送到任何地方。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.settings.readSessionsHelp: 打开开关后，Lithe 会读取插件指定目录中的文件。关闭开关后，Lithe 停止读取，并删除从这些文件缓存的内容。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.settings.noPlugins: 没有已安装的插件请求读取会话文件。
zh-CN.desktop.agents.settings.mcpSearchSwitch: 允许 MCP 客户端搜索本地会话
zh-CN.desktop.agents.settings.mcpSearchHelp: 让项目 IDE 连接上的 MCP 客户端搜索和读取上面已允许的 Agent 的会话，包括所有项目的会话。客户端拿到 Agent、会话 ID、时间和消息文字，拿不到文件路径。只在“设置 › 工具 › IDE 连接”打开时生效；改动后 IDE 连接会重新连接。
